const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Generate a seeded MuJoCo ALOHA hand-over trajectory."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+import rcb_aloha as ra
+
+
+def smoothstep(x: float) -> float:
+    return x * x * (3.0 - 2.0 * x)
+
+
+class SiteIK:
+    """Six joint damped-least-squares IK for the named gripper site."""
+
+    def __init__(self, session: ra.Session):
+        self.s = session
+        self.m = session.model
+        self.mj = session.mj
+        self.d = self.mj.MjData(self.m)
+        self.base_qpos = self.m.key_qpos[self.m.key("home").id].copy()
+        self.jids = {}
+        self.qadr = {}
+        self.dadr = {}
+        for side in ("left", "right"):
+            ids = [self.m.joint(f"{side}/{j}").id for j in
+                   ("waist", "shoulder", "elbow", "forearm_roll", "wrist_angle", "wrist_rotate")]
+            self.jids[side] = ids
+            self.qadr[side] = [int(self.m.jnt_qposadr[i]) for i in ids]
+            self.dadr[side] = [int(self.m.jnt_dofadr[i]) for i in ids]
+        self.sids = {side: self.m.site(f"{side}/gripper").id for side in ("left", "right")}
+
+    def set_pose(self, side: str, q: np.ndarray):
+        self.d.qpos[:] = self.base_qpos
+        self.d.qpos[self.qadr[side]] = q
+        self.mj.mj_forward(self.m, self.d)
+        sid = self.sids[side]
+        return self.d.site_xpos[sid].copy(), self.d.site_xmat[sid].reshape(3, 3).copy()
+
+    def solve(self, side: str, qseed: np.ndarray, pgoal: np.ndarray,
+              rgoal: np.ndarray | None = None) -> tuple[np.ndarray, float, float]:
+        q = np.asarray(qseed, float).copy()
+        pgoal = np.asarray(pgoal, float)
+        if rgoal is None:
+            _, rgoal = self.set_pose(side, qseed)
+        qadr = self.qadr[side]
+        dadr = self.dadr[side]
+        sid = self.sids[side]
+        jpos = np.zeros((3, self.m.nv))
+        jang = np.zeros((3, self.m.nv))
+        lower = self.s.lower[0:6] if side == "left" else self.s.lower[7:13]
+        upper = self.s.upper[0:6] if side == "left" else self.s.upper[7:13]
+
+        for _ in range(160):
+            self.d.qpos[:] = self.base_qpos
+            self.d.qpos[qadr] = q
+            self.mj.mj_forward(self.m, self.d)
+            p = self.d.site_xpos[sid].copy()
+            r = self.d.site_xmat[sid].reshape(3, 3).copy()
+            dp = pgoal - p
+            dr = Rotation.from_matrix(rgoal @ r.T).as_rotvec()
+            if np.linalg.norm(dp) < 2e-6 and np.linalg.norm(dr) < 2e-5:
+                break
+            self.mj.mj_jacSite(self.m, self.d, jpos, jang, sid)
+            jac = np.vstack((jpos[:, dadr], jang[:, dadr]))
+            err = np.concatenate((dp, dr))
+            # Damped least squares avoids large updates near arm singularities.
+            dq = jac.T @ np.linalg.solve(jac @ jac.T + 2e-5 * np.eye(6), err)
+            n = np.linalg.norm(dq)
+            if n > 0.12:
+                dq *= 0.12 / n
+            q = np.clip(q + dq, lower, upper)
+
+        p, r = self.set_pose(side, q)
+        return q, float(np.linalg.norm(pgoal - p)), float(np.linalg.norm(Rotation.from_matrix(rgoal @ r.T).as_rotvec()))
+
+
+def main():
+    out = Path("/app/output")
+    s = ra.Session("/app/instance.json")
+    if s.env != "AlohaHandOver":
+        raise RuntimeError(f"expected AlohaHandOver, got {s.env}")
+    ik = SiteIK(s)
+    m = s.model
+    home_k = m.key("home").id
+    picked_k = m.key("picked").id
+    transferred_k = m.key("transferred").id
+    home = m.key_qpos[home_k].copy()
+    picked = m.key_qpos[picked_k].copy()
+    transferred = m.key_qpos[transferred_k].copy()
+    qhome = {side: home[ik.qadr[side]].copy() for side in ("left", "right")}
+    qpick = {side: picked[ik.qadr[side]].copy() for side in ("left", "right")}
+    qtrans = {side: transferred[ik.qadr[side]].copy() for side in ("left", "right")}
+
+    # Shift the demonstrated hand-over poses by this instance's randomized box offset.
+    off = np.array([s.box_xy[0], s.box_xy[1], 0.0])
+    p_pick_ref, r_pick = ik.set_pose("left", qpick["left"])
+    p_box_pick = picked[16:19].copy()
+    p_box_start = s.state()["box_pos"].copy()
+    # The picked keyframe establishes the grasp transform. Move the hand down along
+    # that transform until the box is still at its randomized starting pose.
+    grasp_offset = p_pick_ref - p_box_pick
+    p_contact = p_box_start + grasp_offset
+    q_contact, ep, er = ik.solve("left", qpick["left"], p_contact, r_pick)
+    q_pick_shift, epp, err = ik.solve("left", qpick["left"], p_pick_ref + off, r_pick)
+    if ep > 0.004 or er > 0.05 or epp > 0.004 or err > 0.05:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"left IK failed contact={ep:.4g}/{er:.4g} picked={epp:.4g}/{err:.4g}")
+
+    # Adapt the model's receiving pose to the shifted object position.
+    p_left_trans, r_left_trans = ik.set_pose("left", qtrans["left"])
+    p_right_trans, r_right_trans = ik.set_pose("right", qtrans["right"])
+    p_left_trans += off
+    p_right_trans += off
+    q_left_trans, ep, er = ik.solve("left", qtrans["left"], p_left_trans, r_left_trans)
+    q_right_trans, epr, err = ik.solve("right", qtrans["right"], p_right_trans, r_right_trans)
+    if max(ep, epr) > 0.004 or max(er, err) > 0.05:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"handover IK failed left={ep:.4g}/{er:.4g}, right={epr:.4g}/{err:.4g}")
+
+    def full(left, right, lg, rg):
+        x = np.empty(14, dtype=float)
+        x[:6] = left
+        x[6] = lg
+        x[7:13] = right
+        x[13] = rg
+        return np.clip(x, s.lower, s.upper)
+
+    def phase(target, steps, label=""):
+        start = s.targets.copy()
+        for i in range(1, steps + 1):
+            u = smoothstep(i / steps)
+            s.step(start + u * (target - start))
+        if label:
+            st = s.state()
+            print(label, "box", np.round(st["box_pos"], 4),
+                  "left", np.round(st["sites"]["left/gripper"], 4),
+                  "right", np.round(st["sites"]["right/gripper"], 4), st["success"])
+
+    s.record_start()
+    s.step(s.targets)  # retain one deterministic initial control sample
+
+    # Descend to a side grasp, close around the box, then lift to the demonstrated pose.
+    phase(full(q_contact, qhome["right"], 0.037, 0.037), 110, "approach")
+    phase(full(q_contact, qhome["right"], 0.002, 0.037), 35, "close_left")
+    phase(full(q_pick_shift, qhome["right"], 0.002, 0.037), 100, "lift")
+    phase(s.targets.copy(), 20, "settle_lift")
+
+    # Carry to the receiving pose. The left fingers retain the object until the
+    # right gripper has closed around it.
+    phase(full(q_left_trans, q_right_trans, 0.002, 0.037), 150, "handover_approach")
+    phase(full(q_left_trans, q_right_trans, 0.002, 0.002), 40, "close_right")
+    phase(s.targets.copy(), 25, "grip_overlap")
+    phase(full(q_left_trans, q_right_trans, 0.037, 0.002), 35, "release_left")
+    phase(full(qhome["left"], q_right_trans, 0.037, 0.002), 100, "left_retreat")
+
+    # Replan the final translation from the observed grasp so contact geometry and
+    # any small simulation offsets at the hand-over are carried into the target.
+    st = s.state()
+    box_before = st["box_pos"].copy()
+    right_now = s.targets[7:13].copy()
+    p_right_now, r_right_now = ik.set_pose("right", right_now)
+    p_goal = p_right_now + (s.target_pos - box_before)
+    q_goal, ep, er = ik.solve("right", right_now, p_goal, r_right_now)
+    print("target IK", "box", np.round(box_before, 5), "target", np.round(s.target_pos, 5),
+          "site goal", np.round(p_goal, 5), "error", ep, er)
+    if ep > 0.004 or er > 0.05:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"target IK failed {ep:.4g}/{er:.4g}")
+    phase(full(qhome["left"], q_goal, 0.037, 0.002), 180, "carry_to_target")
+    phase(s.targets.copy(), 100, "final_hold")
+
+    actions = s.record_stop()
